name: Public Infrastructure Ai
tagline: Public Infrastructure Ai improves public infrastructure, safety, and digital access through community-informed projects.
elevator_pitch: Public Infrastructure Ai bridges residents, agencies, and technologists to ship fixes that are visible and accountable.
mission_detail: We combine participatory design, open metrics, and pragmatic pilots—lighting, connectivity, resilience, and public space.
programs_intro: Wi-Fi zones, sensor transparency dashboards, resilience hubs, and event operations support.
impact_intro: Uptime, coverage maps, incident response times (where partners share), and resident satisfaction.
contact_intro: City departments, utilities, and sponsors: co-fund pilots with public reporting.
